headline: EPS growth accelerates year-over-year
summary_short: MIXI reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥89.47, up 4.4% q/q and up 327.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥89.47 rose 4.4% sequentially from ¥85.66 and surged 327.6% year-over-year from ¥20.92. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
